Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly calculated the lifespans of Antonio Caggiano and Hardyal Singh. Antonio Caggiano's lifespan was 90.75 years (from 30 January 1889 to 23 October 1979), not 89.25 years as stated. Similarly, Hardyal Singh's lifespan was 89.72 years (from 28 November 1928 to 17 August 2018), not 90.25 years. This error occurred because the Planner failed to accurately compute the exact number of years, months, and days for each lifespan. This miscalculation led to the incorrect conclusion that Hardyal Singh lived longer, whereas Antonio Caggiano actually lived longer.
